metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Abiodun Olunu.

plugins.name: page-spec
plugins.description: Write a design brief for an existing feature, layout, website page, component or app screen, from source or a live URL. Organised by user jobs, never by today's layout, so a redesign doesn't copy the current one.

plugins.name: spec-to-todo
plugins.description: Turn a page-spec brief into a build checklist for your project: clashes and decisions first, then every requirement in build order, with what's already built ticked. Keeps the page's shape out of the design agent's brief.
